Original helper 0x42bc40 returns success only after constructing and copying an existing executable path with a nonempty fixed suffix. No call or store intervenes before 0x42be5c tests its first byte; the success-with-empty-output arm cannot execute with the declared physical API contracts.

Original-only archive allocation failure witness proceeds with null receiver to unchanged archive opener 0x4b72e0, which faults reading/writing address 0x20 at instruction 0x4b730c. This two-byte null assignment arm cannot complete valid original execution.
